remarks: Welcome to your dream apartment - a stunning, fully renovated one-bedroom and one-bathroom apartment. This unit boasts a spacious living room and kitchen, meticulously designed with modern finishes and top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, including a refrigerator, electric stove with oven, microwave, and dishwasher. The unit also has high-efficiency heating and cooling units in each room. You can easily regulate the temperature to your liking and enjoy a comfortable living space year-round. The kitchen includes quartz countertops, and soft-close kitchen cabinets, which are both sleek and functional, while the modern recess lighting and luxurious laminate flooring throughout the unit create an ambiance of pure elegance. The fully tiled bathroom features a tub/shower with glass sliding doors, a window for natural light, a recessed wall bathroom heater, an exhaust fan, and a towel bar set. Each unit is also equipped with its own in-unit hot water heater for immediate hot water. For your safety, there is a personal intercom with a screen, camera, microphone, and striker, which allows you to see visitors before allowing them into the building all from your unit. You can also stay connected with cable and fiber optic readiness for high-speed streaming, TV watching, and web surfing. Laundry facilities are conveniently located in the common area, and extra storage is available for rent as well. Major highways, transportation, and shopping centers
